rule: One canonical dataset per metric. Display values must be read from canonical_dataset; alternates in do_not_mix are context only and must be labelled with their definition.

metrics.name: Recorded home sales by buyer residence
metrics.definition: Count of recorded single-family + condo sales by buyer address: Hawaiʻi / other US (mainland) / foreign
metrics.denominator: Share = category ÷ all recorded sales in the area and period
metrics.do_not_mix: Do not mix DBEDT 2024 (18,007) with Title Guaranty 2024 (16,716/16,709): for 2024 compare shares, or use TG for both years. Do not compare recorded counts with MLS counts.
metrics.refresh_class: PUBLISHER-TIMED, QUARTERLY — show the edition and period covered

metrics.name: Average price paid by buyer residence
metrics.definition: Dollar volume ÷ sales for local, mainland, foreign
metrics.do_not_mix: TG panels print rounded dollars ($X.XB); use DBEDT averages for exact values.
metrics.refresh_class: PUBLISHER-TIMED, QUARTERLY — show the edition and period covered

metrics.name: Top out-of-state buyer states and foreign countries
metrics.definition: Top-10 states (incl. Hawaiʻi) and up to 5 countries per panel, by count and dollars
metrics.denominator: Listed states cover ~73–82% of other-US buyers; no full state list exists
metrics.do_not_mix: Rank only within one edition; later editions restate. Japan/Korea/Canada = buyer address country, never nationality.
metrics.refresh_class: PUBLISHER-TIMED, QUARTERLY — show the edition and period covered

metrics.name: Buyer residence by Title Guaranty district
metrics.definition: District other-US share = (US TOTAL − Hawaiʻi row) ÷ (US TOTAL + FOREIGN TOTAL)
metrics.do_not_mix: Hilo 2024 includes a one-off batch of 232 California-address transfers (~$151K each): use 2025+ for district trends. Districts are TG’s own, not ZIPs or tax districts.
metrics.refresh_class: PUBLISHER-TIMED, QUARTERLY — show the edition and period covered

metrics.name: Oʻahu buyers by price tier (2023–25)
metrics.definition: Recorded sales matched to the Oct 2026 owner roll by buyer mailing address; local/mainland/foreign share per tier
metrics.denominator: Deals with a classifiable address, institutional addresses excluded
metrics.do_not_mix: Use TG for island-wide levels; this join is for tier comparisons (calibrated within ~1–4 pt of TG). $10M+ cell n=14: indicative only.

metrics.name: Maui sales to buyers without a homeowner exemption
metrics.definition: Share of Maui sales recorded on the non-homeowner conveyance-tax schedule, by FY and price bin
metrics.denominator: All Maui sales in the FY/bin
metrics.do_not_mix: Not the same as out-of-state: includes local landlords and investors. Do not present as a count of second homes. Title Guaranty Maui mainland share (25% in 2025) measures something different; show both with this caveat.

metrics.name: $3M+ and $10M+ sales counts
metrics.definition: Company-reported MLS counts of sales at $3M+ and $10M+
metrics.do_not_mix: Company-reported; label Reported. Rebuilding from public records is future work.
metrics.validation_status: verified as transcribed; source is reported

metrics.name: MLS sales counts and median prices
metrics.definition: Monthly single-family and condo resales and medians
metrics.canonical_dataset: handoff/refresh/state/last_good/dbedt_mei_county_housing.json (automated; supersedes the page_data.json#islands snapshot for months after 2026-08)
metrics.do_not_mix: Monthly medians are not annual medians; do not average them into an annual median. The September 2026 board figures in #now are a first look (BOARD_MLS_STATS); keep DBEDT_MEI canonical for the monthly series once September lands (about 2026-10-29). YTD: show DBEDT's published YTD (ytd_published); the sum of monthly rows is lower for the current year on the neighbor islands. Never derive a statewide median.
metrics.refresh_class: PUBLISHER-TIMED, MONTHLY — show “as of <month>” and the next expected release from source_registry.json

metrics.name: District YTD sales and medians, 2026 vs 2025
metrics.definition: MLS resales and YTD medians by board district, houses and condos
metrics.geography: Board districts on all four islands
metrics.newest_period: Jan–Aug 2026 (Maui Jan–Sep); island-level September 2026 in sources/market_oct.json
metrics.do_not_mix: Recorded (TG/DBEDT) and MLS counts differ (developer closings); quote separately.
metrics.refresh_class: PUBLISHER-TIMED, MONTHLY — show “as of <month>” and the next expected release from source_registry.json

metrics.name: Oʻahu repeat-sales price index
metrics.definition: Weighted repeat-sales index, 2015 = 100, island and TMK zone
metrics.do_not_mix: Extract keeps latest two sales per parcel; 2025 thin after April.

metrics.name: Active listings, days on market, price-cut share
metrics.definition: Realtor.com monthly listing metrics
metrics.denominator: Price-cut share = listings with a reduction ÷ active listings
metrics.do_not_mix: Maui County flagged lower quality every month Dec 2025–Sep 2026; Kauaʻi Sep 2026 price-cut share (4.8%) is a data gap (use Aug 15.2% with note). ZIP YoY suppressed where Sep 2025 had <10 listings.
metrics.refresh_class: LIVE — reuse the existing Hawaiʻi Intelligence inventory feed; show its last successful refresh timestamp. The report’s Realtor.com September 2026 values are a dated snapshot for history only.

metrics.name: Months of supply
metrics.definition: Realtor.com active listings ÷ 3-month average DBEDT sales
metrics.do_not_mix: Maui board’s own figure differs (11.0 overall; houses 7.8, condos 12.1) from the report’s 9.6: label the method on every display; prefer board data for Maui. September 2026 board figures: Oʻahu houses 3.2 / condos 7.0 (HBR), Maui houses 7.8 / condos 12.1 (RAM); boards use active ÷ 12-month average closed. The report's method rolled to September (provisional, until DBEDT September): Oʻahu 5.2, Maui 10.4, Kauaʻi 9.6, Hawaiʻi Island 7.1.
metrics.refresh_class: DERIVED, MIXED CADENCE — live inventory ÷ publisher-timed DBEDT monthly sales; show both as-of dates; never label as live.

metrics.name: 30-year fixed mortgage rate
metrics.definition: Freddie Mac PMMS weekly average
metrics.do_not_mix: page_data monthly October 2026 point (7.28) is only the first week: recompute when the month closes; use the weekly series in a weekly brief.
metrics.refresh_class: LIVE — reuse the existing Hawaiʻi Intelligence mortgage-rate feed; show its last successful refresh timestamp. The report’s PMMS values (Oct 8, 2026: 7.40%) are a dated snapshot for history only.

metrics.name: Mortgage payment on a median house ÷ median household income
metrics.definition: 30-yr P&I on 80% of county median single-family price at the annual average PMMS rate, ÷ ACS median household income
metrics.denominator: Median household income (2025 uses 2024 income held flat)
metrics.recommended_surface: annual (refresh monthly only if rates move materially)
metrics.do_not_mix: Excludes taxes, insurance and HOA dues. Price vs rate attribution depends on order: on Oʻahu each 14–24 points; state as a range.

metrics.name: Income, home value, rent, tenure, vacancy
metrics.definition: ACS 1-year county estimates
metrics.do_not_mix: Survey estimates with margins of error.

metrics.name: Homes held for seasonal or occasional use
metrics.definition: ACS PUMS seasonal vacancy ÷ housing units

metrics.name: Housing units authorized
metrics.definition: Census BPS units authorized
metrics.do_not_mix: Permits ≠ completions.
metrics.validation_status: not independently re-verified in this PR
metrics.refresh_class: PUBLISHER-TIMED, MONTHLY — show “as of <month>” and the next expected release from source_registry.json

metrics.name: Visitor arrivals (domestic, international)
metrics.definition: DBEDT monthly arrivals by air
metrics.do_not_mix: HTA series repeats Maui 2021 as 2022: use DBEDT series only.
metrics.refresh_class: PUBLISHER-TIMED, MONTHLY — show “as of <month>” and the next expected release from source_registry.json

metrics.name: Visitor origin metros and over-index by island
metrics.definition: Metro’s island share ÷ all-metro island share; Utah’s three metros combined
metrics.canonical_dataset: sources/visitors_2025.json (2025, current); vis_cbsa.json and sources/visitors.json (2024 history)
metrics.do_not_mix: Visitors signal interest, not buyers. Show the 2025 lists as current; show 2024 only as history with its year. Rankings shift from year to year (Maui: Minneapolis 1.31× in 2024, 1.09× in 2025).

metrics.name: Household moves in and out (IRS)
metrics.definition: Tax returns moving between Hawaiʻi counties and US counties/states; AGI per return
metrics.do_not_mix: Households, not buyers or sellers. “Fastest-growing exit” depends on base years: from 2004–08 Denver/SLC/Portland; from 2011–14 Las Vegas (+60%). State both.
metrics.validation_status: verified (2013–14+ hash-matched; earlier mirror files unchecked)

metrics.name: Mortgaged purchases not for a main home; VA share
metrics.definition: HMDA originated purchase loans: second home + investment share; VA loan share; by tier and county subdivision
metrics.do_not_mix: Financed purchases only. Do not call it “won’t live there”; second homes are part-time use. 2019 vs 2025 tiers are nominal dollars (price-adjusted 2019 luxury share ≈54% vs 71% nominal).

metrics.name: Residential parcels owned from outside Hawaiʻi
metrics.definition: Owner tax-bill mailing address outside Hawaiʻi ÷ residential parcels with an address
metrics.denominator: Residential parcels with a mailing address
metrics.do_not_mix: Stock of ownership, not purchases. Aggregates only. Kauaʻi and Hawaiʻi County mailing addresses are not public; their owner-occupancy figures (owner_occupancy_kauai_hawaii) are a different measure and do not go in this row. Homeowner-exemption status does not prove a home’s use.

metrics.name: Out-of-state buyer share by houses/condos and ZIP
metrics.definition: UHERO: buyer deed address outside Hawaiʻi
metrics.do_not_mix: Do not label Kihei as having the most out-of-state condo buyers of any ZIP (it ranks 3rd by count).

metrics.name: Vacation rentals as share of homes
metrics.definition: UHERO STR share of housing
metrics.do_not_mix: Listing counts include illegal units.

metrics.name: 2027 recorded-sales scenarios
metrics.definition: Log-linear fit of annual recorded sales on annual PMMS rate, 2015–2025 (as-published counts)
metrics.do_not_mix: Model, not a forecast of record; 2023 undershot the model.
metrics.refresh_class: MODEL — refresh when annual inputs change

metrics.name: Why-box explanations
metrics.definition: Researcher + skeptic checked narrative with drivers ranked strong/moderate/weak
metrics.do_not_mix: Correlation/context unless the box says otherwise; drivers marked “an association, not proof” must keep that label.
metrics.validation_status: verified: final audit confirmed 73 findings; 58 applied to the report; the other 15 concerned only the internal go-to-market page, now archived and not ported. Citation dates re-checked 2026-10-09.
metrics.refresh_class: NARRATIVE — revise when the underlying metrics change

metrics.name: Lahaina/Kula unsolicited-offer ban
metrics.definition: Governor’s wildfire proclamations
metrics.do_not_mix: Must be re-checked around 2026-10-23.
metrics.refresh_class: EVENT-DRIVEN — re-check on the publisher’s schedule

metrics.name: Homes taxed as owner-occupied (Kauaʻi) / house lots with a homeowner exemption (Hawaiʻi County)
metrics.definition: Kauaʻi: residential tax records in the owner-occupied classes ÷ residential tax records (condo units counted once each). Hawaiʻi County: house lots with a homeowner exemption ÷ house lots (Residential or Agricultural class with a building).
metrics.denominator: Kauaʻi: 27,097 residential records; Hawaiʻi County: 66,761 house lots
metrics.geography: Kauaʻi (5 districts, zone-sections); Hawaiʻi County (9 districts)
metrics.newest_period: Kauaʻi TY2026–27; Hawaiʻi County certified April 2026
metrics.do_not_mix: Not an origin measure and not off-island ownership: "not owner-occupied" includes local landlords, long-term rentals, family-held and second homes and vacation rentals. The two counties use different units (Kauaʻi per unit by tax class; Hawaiʻi County per lot by exemption), so do not compare them directly or with Oʻahu/Maui origin shares. Never present a missing exemption as proof of a second home.

metrics.name: Island sales and medians, latest month (board reports)
metrics.definition: Single-family and condo closed sales, medians and board months of supply for the latest month, from each island board
metrics.do_not_mix: A first look ahead of DBEDT_MEI; once DBEDT publishes the month, the monthly series uses DBEDT. Kauaʻi monthly counts are under 20; quote counts, not rates.

live_vs_publisher_timed: Only the two LIVE metrics come from Hawaiʻi Intelligence’s existing feeds. Do not add a competing live dataset from this report. Everything else is publisher-timed: display its period and next release; never label it live.
